title: I grew up playing ARC, so I built my own browser arena shooter with Claude Code
author: Silent_Ad1589
selftext:
I grew up playing ARC with friends when I was a kid and loved it. I wanted that feeling back in something anyone can open from a link, so I built SaucerJam with Claude Code.

You fly a saucer and fight with three weapons: a laser, a grenade that arcs to where you aim, and a ricochet shot that bounces off walls up to three times. Free-for-all, 2 or 4 teams, or Capture the Core, across three arenas. It runs in the browser on desktop and phone. No download, no account. Practice against bots, or send friends a private room link.

How it got built: I started with Cursor some time ago, finished with Astra, and polished it with Opus 5.5.

I’ve been a software developer for 5+ years but had never built a game. This is my first one, and now that AI can build just about anything, I’m looking to learn in general. 

Please share your feedback. 

Play: [https://saucerjam.com](https://saucerjam.com)

Thanks for checking it out!
